title: Hemlo - Day & Meal Planner
short_description: A calm planner for your day, meals, shopping and habits. Works offline.
full_description:
Hemlo keeps your day on one page. Tasks sit on a time rail down the margin, the way you would write them in a notebook. Anything that slips stays where it was, marked, until you give it a new time. The round + adds whatever you need; everything else waits in the ⋮ until you want it.

PLAN THE DAY
• Tasks with a time and a length, or none; lock one so nothing moves it
• Push something 15, 30 or 60 minutes with one tap; anything pushed three times asks for a new slot
• Repeat on set days, or every few days
• The week, the load on each day of the month, and the whole year, with your goals and milestones
• Notes with checklists and templates, and an inbox for what has no day yet

PLAN THE MEALS
• Put your own recipes, or single foods, on the day
• Calories and protein are worked out from what is in each recipe, using the Dutch NEVO food table
• Scan or search supermarket products through Open Food Facts
• Targets from your height, weight and activity, with the arithmetic shown

SHOP AND COOK
• The shopping list fills itself from the meal plan, less what is already in the cupboard
• Aisles in your shop's order, several lists, and a basket you tick as you go
• Your own prices per shop, and shared ones from Open Prices where people have reported them; never a guess
• A cupboard with places, best-before dates and a minimum that puts things back on the list
• Share a household: the list, the cupboard, prices and chores, each person's own plan kept private

MODULES YOU CHOOSE
Habits, chores, supplements, training, sleep, projects, finance and reading, each off until you turn it on. Build your own module with the fields you need. Stats turn any of it into a figure or a chart, on a page or a home-screen widget.

WORKS WITHOUT A CONNECTION
Everything is on your phone first. Tick things off in a shop with no signal; it syncs across your devices when you are back online.

REMINDERS
Optional reminders at a task's time, with quiet hours. On a locked phone they show no text.

YOUR DATA
No advertising, no tracking, nothing sold, and Hemlo collects no analytics. Your data is stored in the EU. Export everything in one file, or delete your account from the app at any time. Sharing a price with Open Prices is optional, one price at a time, and only when you tap Share.

Hemlo is a planning tool. It does not give medical advice, and its calorie and protein targets are general estimates, not a prescription.
